text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary rollout 'promptv2-route' (rev r123) showing elevated 500s and malformed JSON completions. Error rate 6.8% > threshold 2.0%. Auto-failover attempted to stable-route and paging oncall.

mike_oncall: I'm on it, looking now. Paging @olivia_sre and @sara_eng.

pagerduty-bot: Pager sent to @mike_oncall, @olivia_sre (incident open).

mike_oncall: Seeing increased latency + truncated responses in traces. Any customer reports? @javier_support can you confirm?

javier_support: Two enterprise customers reported corrupt completions and retried requests spiked ~11:21 UTC. CS is escalating and collecting examples.

sara_eng: Logs show kernel-selection fallback thrashing KV cache on host gpu-4 during long-sequence requests. A new path from r123 looks suspect.

ashley_prodeng: Traffic to promptv2-route ~12% globally, but error budget burn concentrated on seq > 2k tokens. That explains why only some sessions fail.

olivia_sre: Recommend disabling the feature flag and diverting traffic back to stable. Command I will run: `./infra/flagsctl set promptv2-routing false --env=prod --reason="canary-500s"`

mike_oncall: Execute and confirm.

olivia_sre: Done. CLI: `OK - promptv2-routing=false (was true) - propagated to edge clusters`. Propagation to all edges underway (~75s expected).

deploy-bot: Observability update: request percentage to promptv2-route dropping toward 0% within 90s. Error-rate on stable-route trending back to baseline.

javier_support: CS notified affected customers with mitigation steps and an initial ETA for a postmortem.

mike_oncall: As a precaution let's rollback canary revision r123 to r122. Running: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/prompt-router --to-revision=122`

sara_eng: Rollback started. Watch pods: `kubectl get pods -l app=prompt-router -w` — seeing new pods spin up.

ops-bot: Rollback complete across prod clusters. prompt-router pods ready=3/3 in prod-us-east-1, prod-eu-west-1.

mike_oncall: Metrics check: error-rate normalized, tail latency returned to baseline. Holding flag off and halting rollout. Assigning RCA to @sara_eng + @olivia_sre.

ashley_prodeng: Filing incident ticket and preparing customer-facing summary. Will attach logs and sample corrupt completions.

olivia_sre: On-call handoff: @sara_eng will lead triage for next 4h. I am handing off monitoring and will remain available. @mike_oncall standing down from pager.

mike_oncall: Handing off and closing PD incident. :white_check_mark: Good work everyone.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-854: "Feature flag kill & rollback for promptv2-route" — Severity P2. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-854

sara_eng: Initial notes: kernel selection fallback introduced in r123 can cause KV cache eviction storms when sequence-length distribution spikes. Repro on staging with synthetic long sequences.

javier_support: Customers requested ETA for fix; CS will send hourly status updates until RCA complete.

mike_oncall: Thank you. Please add timeline and remediation steps to the incident doc: https://docs.internal/incident/INC-2026-854/pm

ashley_prodeng: Postmortem owners assigned. We'll include impact matrix (customers, regions, tokens affected) and escalation notes.

sara_eng: Next steps: reproduce in staging, prepare a patch to kernel selector, run extended long-seq canary, and then stagger rollout smaller slices.

mike_oncall: Closing thread for now — re-open if any regressions. :lock:
